CmsSectionDocument.title: CMS Section Document
CmsSectionDocument.description: Modular website content section document stored in /cms_sections/{docId}, containing structured section fields, repeatable items, soft-deletion state, and revision metadata.

docId.description: Stable section document identifier matching the Firestore document ID.

pageId.description: Logical page group identifier (e.g., shared, home, destinations, packages, stays, gallery, our-story, contact, booking).

title.description: Human-readable section title for the admin editor.

revision.description: Monotonically increasing revision number used for optimistic concurrency control.

deleted.description: Whether the entire section document is soft-deleted.

deletedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp if soft-deleted, or null.

deletedBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator who soft-deleted the section, or null.

updatedBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator who performed the write.

payload.description: Native Firestore Map containing structured section copy, subsections, and repeatable items with { url, key, alt } image references.

CustomerEnquiry.title: Customer Enquiry
CustomerEnquiry.description: Private customer booking or contact enquiry submitted from the website. Never publicly readable.

id.description: Unique enquiry identifier matching the document ID.

selectedPackage.description: Selected tour package or custom journey label.

MediaObjectRecord.title: R2 Media Object Lifecycle Record
MediaObjectRecord.description: Tracks the lifecycle status of an R2 media object (active, deleting, deleted) to prevent concurrent content saves from assigning an image while it is being permanently deleted.

id.description: Deterministic encoded media document ID derived from objectKey.

objectKey.description: Exact Cloudflare R2 object key under an approved prefix.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the R2 object.

updatedBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator who updated the lifecycle status.

/cms_sections/{docId}.description: Publicly readable website content sections. Only authenticated administrators with request.auth.token.admin == true can create, update, or delete.

/customer_enquiries/{enquiryId}.description: Private customer enquiries containing PII. Public visitors may create validated enquiries; only administrators with request.auth.token.admin == true may read, update, or delete.

/media_objects/{mediaId}.description: Administrator-only R2 media object lifecycle records used to coordinate safe permanent deletion and block concurrent content saves.
